name: Anchor Browser

modes.label: Cloud browser session (Infrastructure plan: $0.05/browser-hour + $0.01/browser)
modes.note: $0.01 per browser created + $0.05 per browser-hour on 'total active time of the browser session, calculated to the nearest full minute'; paid from dollar-denominated credits (1 credit = $1). Browser vCPU/RAM undisclosed (sizes vcpu/ram null - treat one session as one browser). Sessions live until max_duration (default 20 min per API / 180 min per guide; -1 = unlimited) or idle_timeout (default 5 min after last disconnect) - idle tail likely billed. Proxy $8/GB extra; non-proxy egress $0.20/GB (network.egress_gib). AI tasks/steps priced separately.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: $5 (5 credits) per month; 5 sessions/min; up to 500 browser sessions; US only; no geolocation proxy/CAPTCHA/auth.

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: $50/month = 50 credits ($50) usage; overage $1/credit. 25 sessions/min. US only.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: Listed on anchorbrowser.io/pricing (2026-09-28) but absent from docs pricing table: $500/month = 500 credits, 50 concurrent, 30-day retention, custom proxy, Cloudflare verified agents.

plans.name: Growth
plans.note: $2,000/month = 2,000 credits; 100 sessions/min; code execution, full stealth, BYO proxy, EU/Asia/Australia regions, SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: 500+ concurrent, HIPAA/BAA/SSO, ZDR, any region, BYOC/on-prem.

features.ip_note: Anchor residential proxy $8/GB with country/region/city targeting; BYO HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy or proxyless egress billed $0.20/GB; dedicated sticky IP available; CAPTCHA solving from Starter ($50/mo), Extra Stealth on Growth.

extras.price: $8/GB (replaces the $0.20/GB egress rate for proxied traffic)
$0.10 per completed task + AI steps $0.01/$0.05/$0.10 by model tier (BYOK $0.01)

extras.item: Dedicated sticky IP / Anchor VPN / volumes

caveats: Browser product: priced per browser-hour ($0.05) + $0.01 per browser created, undisclosed browser resources and isolation; not comparable to a 4 vCPU/8 GiB VM.
Credits are dollars (Free '$5 free credits' = '5 credits'; overage $1/credit); plan fees convert 1:1 into credits (fee_is_credit).
Free plan $5/month encoded as plans[Free].included_usd; free.monthly_credit left 0 to avoid double counting on paid plans.
Team plan ($500, 50 concurrent) appears only on the marketing pricing page, not in docs; if unavailable, 26-200 concurrent requires Growth ($2,000).
Egress: $0.20/GB when proxyless or BYO proxy; Anchor proxy traffic is $8/GB instead (not modelled as egress).
Card regions = us only: infrastructure is US-hosted on Free/Starter/Team; EU/Asia/Australia need Growth ($2,000) and any region needs Enterprise.

Billing rounds to the nearest full minute (not clear if up); idle time before idle_timeout (default 5 min) likely billed; default max_duration 20 min (API) vs 180 min (guide) - long sessions must raise it.

fleet.tiers: Free 5; Starter 25; Team 50 (pricing page); Growth 200; Enterprise 500+ by sales. Creation-rate limits separate: free 5/min, Starter 25/min, Growth 100/min.
fleet.notes: Browser-session slots, not general-purpose VMs. Docs omit the Team tier listed by pricing; published self-serve tiers do not alone establish 300/1,000 capacity. Enterprise needs contact; turnaround and identity screening unknown.
